title: Relative flatness and a flat fibre stalk give a free neighbourhood
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Let $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$, and $\mathcal F_s$ be its tensor pullback to the fibre $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-module-pullback]. Assume $\mathcal F_x$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over] and $(\mathcal F_s)_x$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{X_s,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then there are an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq X$ of $x$ and an integer $r\geq0$ with $\mathcal F|_W\cong\mathcal O_W^{\oplus r}$.
